name: Text Expander Lite
privacy: All snippets and variables are stored locally. No cloud account, telemetry, or PackRat service is required.
listing_summary: Save reusable text snippets and insert dynamic text from Stream Deck. Lite supports up to 10 local snippets plus {date}, {time}, and {clipboard}, with Unicode, emoji, multiline text, URLs, and code snippets.
pro_url_rule: Do not show a Pro Marketplace button until the real Text Expander Pro listing URL has been created and verified.
release_gate: locked dependency install and deterministic build
high-severity runtime dependency audit with patched ws 8.21.0

36 automated Windows tests covering native Win32 INPUT sizing and bridge compilation, variables, Unicode, persistence, corruption recovery, counters, local templates, reserved variables, stale snippet repair, library-manager refresh, Lite/Pro storage isolation, scalable lazy PI transport, Smart multiline/tab behavior, clipboard hardening, bridge timeout, schema-v3 migration, future-safe Pro URL injection, and semantic/no-rail key visuals
bundled Stream Deck profile archive structural validation
shared Stream Deck key-face visual audit with 0 errors/warnings plus manual 72x72 and 36x36 review
official Stream Deck SDK v2 / SDKVersion 3
official Elgato Stream Deck CLI validation
deterministic Rat Art search icon, cover, and four distinct gallery frames
real Windows insertion smoke in Notepad, browser, Discord, multiline editor, and code editor
clipboard restoration and blocked-synthetic-input fallback smoke
final_boundary: Run plugins/text-expander/REAL_WINDOWS_SMOKE.md against the validated package bytes recorded in automated_release_evidence. Stage/publish Pro first; once its direct Marketplace URL is verified, add it to products/lite-pro-map.json, rebuild/revalidate Lite so its upgrade button becomes live, then ship Lite.

automated_release_evidence.native_windows_bridge: PASS - hosted Windows compiled and executed the corrected full Win32 INPUT union; x64 INPUT size is asserted at 40 bytes (x86 28), fixing the keyboard-only union that caused SendInput to fail on real key presses
automated_release_evidence.structural_qa: PASS - canonical PI transport/actionContext, stale selection repair, schema-v3 migration, Lite/Pro isolation, lazy 5,000-snippet PI transport, semantic runtime key rendering, no generic decorative top accent rail, distinct Follow Up glyph, simplified Link glyph, five device profiles, future-safe Pro URL injection, and official-package hardware identity tooling
automated_release_evidence.key_visual_audit: PASS - Lite and Pro, 0 structural errors and 0 warnings
automated_release_evidence.rat_art_visual_review: PASS - deterministic Marketplace art rendered for both editions; runtime semantic keys are covered by no-rail and distinct-glyph regressions plus key visual audit
automated_release_evidence.hardware_press_fix: The previous bridge declared an undersized INPUT union containing only KEYBDINPUT. Native INPUT must be 40 bytes on x64 because the union includes MOUSEINPUT/HARDWAREINPUT. The corrected bridge declares the full union and validates its size before SendInput.
automated_release_evidence.global_key_visual_rule: Canonical main now bans generic decorative PackRat orange rails/bars/stripes on hardware key faces; orange is reserved for semantic detail. Shared key visual audit rejects long orange top rails.
automated_release_evidence.host_smoke_identity: Local combined smoke uses the official Elgato packer, unpacks the temporary package, and compares stable relative-path/file-byte SHA256 content to the validated unpacked-content hash before linking.
automated_release_evidence.package_container_note: Outer .streamDeckPlugin SHA256 can change across equivalent pack operations because ZIP metadata can vary. Use unpacked-content SHA256 for exact-content host QA.

blocker: Real Windows/physical Stream Deck smoke has not yet been recorded as PASS.
upsell_status: Upgrade reasons are implemented, but the Pro button intentionally remains hidden until the real direct Text Expander Pro Marketplace URL is created and verified.
